text:
maria: Quick heads-up — vendor NoriAI reached out wanting to list a LLaMA-derivative on our marketplace with a dual-license (open research + commercial sublicense). Need to confirm what we require from them for onboarding and whether the HW bundle can ship under the same terms.

sam: Thanks — couple questions: do they allow redistribution at all? and do they require attribution / model card in the listing?

leah: We'll need a clear announcement cadence if they're doing an embargoed joint launch. propose: 2 weeks partner review -> 1 week partner signoff -> canary -> general listing. Also need co-branded assets.

legal-team: @maria @sam short checklist we need from the vendor before we can accept: model card, SPDX or license text, a redistribution grant (explicit), provenance statement for training data, weights checksum, export-control classification (EAR/ITAR if applicable), and a signed DPA/CLA for commercial sublicensing. If dual-license, we need the exact permissive license copy + commercial redistribution terms.

ashok: From HW partner side: if we want to offer an NVIDIA-A100 bundle SKU, the partner has to agree to the bundle SKU mapping and revenue split. also confirm whether the weights can be included in the bundle or must be retrieved from partner S3 at deploy time.

jonah: Ops notes: private deployments (VPC/on-prem) require KMS/HSM integration for customer keys and SCIM/SAML for SI integrations. also ask them to provide model artifacts in a tarball with sha256 sums and a small installation script. Example:

```
# expected package layout
model.tar.gz  -> sha256: abc123...
model-card.md
license.txt
install.sh
```

maria: Good — can we add a gating rule that marketplace listing is blocked until legal approves license + export classification? want to avoid accidental redistributions. Also need a clear field in the listing for "Allowed commercial use: yes/no".

leah: For announcements: partner PR embargo window: pick a firm date. we should schedule 3 short integration demos for SIs (one internal, one with partner SIs, one external customer demo) in the week before GA. partner to provide demo script + test prompts.

legal-team: Also request indemnity language and a simple SLA for model availability if they want our "hosted" badge. if they refuse indemnity we can still list as third-party with disclaimer.

ashok: FYI hardware marketing needs final SKU and bundle image at least 5 business days before announcement.

sam: Can we create a one-page vendor onboarding form to collect all this? I can draft and ping NoriAI.

deploy-bot: created checklist document: https://internal.redwood.com/docs/partnerships/noriai-onboarding-checklist (access: partnerships + legal)

maria: Perfect. @sam please add the export-control question as mandatory. @legal-team please review the draft when ready. aiming for co-announcement w/in 4 weeks. :thumbsup:

jonah: I'll add the install script sanity tests to our CI (small smoke deploy) once we get the tarball. will need a test VPC + small GPU queue.

leah: I'll coordinate the demo slots and SE coverage. tagging partner contacts in follow-up thread. :calendar:
__notes: Thread mimics a short partnership coordination convo about open model dual-licensing, HW bundle SKUs, onboarding artifacts, embargo/announcement cadence, and gating rules. Single continuous string of messages as required.
